notes: The league expanded from 16 to 18 clubs for 2026-27 (four promoted from the FUFA Big League, two relegated in 2025-26), so 18 is the current shape and 16 was last season's. 34 rounds. Bottom four go down to the FUFA Big League, which is not in our rows, hence closed_down=true: those four leave the modelled pyramid and four replacements arrive from outside it. Champion enters the CAF Champions League. No play-off at either end of the table.
